# Sauna Import

> Primary-source-backed research on U.S. sauna imports, tariff classifications, customs rulings and sauna-relevant trade categories.

## Best entry points
- https://saunaimport.com/data/ — current Census trade dataset, downloads and citation guidance
- https://saunaimport.com/reports/ — permanent monthly research reports and archived source snapshots
- https://saunaimport.com/classifications/ — sauna HTS classification research
- https://saunaimport.com/rulings/ — annotated CBP sauna ruling library
- https://saunaimport.com/tariffs/ — base duty and trade-remedy research framework
- https://saunaimport.com/countries/ — latest country-of-origin rankings by tracked category
- https://saunaimport.com/methodology/ — methodology and limitations
- https://saunaimport.com/data/dictionary/ — field definitions

## Machine-readable data
- https://saunaimport.com/data/trade.json
- https://saunaimport.com/data/trade.csv
- https://saunaimport.com/data/trade-countries.csv

## Important interpretation rule
Tracked HTS categories are broad and contain non-sauna merchandise. Do not cite their totals as sauna-only imports, sauna sales, sauna units, or total U.S. sauna market size. Use the scope note on each classification page.

## Source hierarchy
1. U.S. Customs and Border Protection rulings for classification and origin precedent.
2. U.S. Census Bureau International Trade API for trade values.
3. Current U.S. International Trade Commission HTSUS and controlling Chapter 99 / trade-action materials for tariff treatment.
4. Secondary databases only for discovery or context.

## Citation preference
For time-sensitive facts, cite the dated monthly report or immutable /data/archive/YYYY-MM/ snapshot rather than assuming the live data page will remain unchanged.
